verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the full flow. Deposit destinations can act as liquidation addresses that auto-convert incoming funds before crediting the account. A guide covers accepting USDC, auto-converting it to USD and collecting it in treasury. Payment acceptance includes fiat settlement, and fiat payouts go out over ACH, Fedwire, Swift or SEPA. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-liquidation to fiat works in practice.
